comment_corrections: Source constants and WD helpers required by the two origin generators; no game dependency.
Source constants and WD helpers used by shared origin layouts; no game dependency.
Native effects for GT6's complete origin layouts. Never writes or forces loads outside this chunk.
Native adapter for origin layouts. Block writes stay in this chunk; reads may inspect loaded neighbours.

geometry_projection.method: Source-extracted Boolean expressions; module flags true, Overworld chunk minima on a 16-block grid. Not Java/native feature execution.

positive_scope: Native canWrite limits block mutation to current chunk and actual height bounds.
Native biome operation actually fills this chunk biome palette; it is not a stub.
Spawn seaLevel+8 equals plan height seaLevel+3 plus source +5.
Road entity cleanup in both sources targets living non-player entities; no false all-entity finding.
Current weighted bedrock grid rejects all 144 center chunks, so no current bedrock centre leak is claimed.
limits: Missing guards are source-entry contracts, not proof every random attempt produces a surviving visible error.
Origin can rewrite earlier terrain; same-stage ordering of pits and origin is not proved by zz filename.
No global mutable flag was added to parallel native generation.
No gameplay/config values, IDs, assets or generation results intentionally changed.
No Gradle, Java compile, GameTest, game, world restart, build, push, GitHub comment or issue close.
